title: planner check plugin output
description: Output of a plugin at the planner:check extension point: the problems it found in the plan, at most 500.

issues.description: Problems found in the plan; empty when the plan passes. More than 500 issues make the output invalid.

severity.description: Whether the problem fails the plan check.

code.description: Stable code of the problem, set by the plugin.

ref.description: Reference in the plan the problem belongs to, such as P1.2.

path.description: File the problem belongs to, relative to the plan folder.
